https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5544\n\n## [2.0.2] - 2025-02-16\n\n### Fixed\n\n- Fixed OptionList.add_options exhausting iterator https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5540\n- Fixed https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5403\n- Added `from_app_focus` to `Focus` event to indicate if a widget is being focused because the app itself has regained focus or not https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5379\n- Added `Blurred` message to `Input` widget (matching `Submitted` and `Changed`) to make it easier to synchronize with `validate_on` parameter when set https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added `Region.bottom_right_inclusive` https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added double click to select, triple click to select all in container https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added arbitrary text selection https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added Widget.ALLOW_SELECT classvar for a per-widget switch to disable text selection https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added Widget.allow_select method for programmatic control of text selection https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added App.ALLOW_SELECT for a global switch to disable text selection https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added `DOMNode.query_ancestor` https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5409\n- Added selection to Log widget https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5467\n- Added `text-wrap` and `text-overflow` CSS values https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5485\n- Added Textual markup to replace Rich markup https://github.com/Textualize/textual/pull/5485\n- Added `Content.from_markup` {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdgBN4VBAFDtrR4wXqijx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The fix is complete and minimal.\n\n## Summary\n\n**The regression:** The app's outer container (`Vertical#main_tab`) has `align: center middle`. Inside it are a `DataTable` (`height: 1fr`) and a `Horizontal` button row (`height: auto`). After the framework upgrade, the layout engine computed the alignment offset by comparing the children's bounding box against the container's *full* size (`dock_region.size`) — **even along axes where the container is auto-sized**.\n\nThe `Vertical` is auto-*height* by default, so its height already equals the sum of its children. But the engine still treated it as if it had extra vertical slack and applied a `middle` centering offset, pushing everything downward. That's why in the \"after\" screenshot the DataTable shrank, the button row slid to the middle, and the docked \"Last Updated\" label detached above the buttons.\n\n**The fix** (`src/textual/_arrange.py`): When measuring available space for alignment, use `0` for any axis on which the container is auto-sized (`is_auto_width` / `is_auto_height`), and the real container size only on axes with an explicit/fixed size. An auto axis has no slack to distribute, so no centering offset is applied along it. This is the exact upstream fix from Textual PR #5552 (issue #5550), which lands in the release after 2.0.4.\n\n**Verification:**\n- Reconstructed the exact app from the screenshots and rendered it: before the fix it matched the broken \"after\" screenshot; after the fix it matches the expected \"before\" screenshot (DataTable fills the height, controls pinned to the bottom, \"Last Updated\" back on the button row).\n- The guarantee that containers with explicit min/max sizes keep placing contents exactly as before holds: those axes are *not* auto, so they still use the real container size — confirmed by 40 passing align/auto/dock/min-height/max-height snapshot tests and 33 passing arrange/layout unit tests.\n- Full snapshot suite: identical pass/fail counts with and without the change (the 19 failures are pre-existing environmental baseline mismatches, unrelated to layout). No new regressions.\n\nOnly the framework's layout engine changed; the application code and stylesheet were untouched."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":482,"cache_read_input_tokens":61941,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":482,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b19934dd-e2c8-454f-beef-21936472f660","uuid":"ee78d56c-3682-4a9c-b914-ccbd8583a753","timestamp":"2026-08-03T17:05:46.550Z"}
